summary: Valaris Ltd filed this 8-K to disclose that it received a Second Request from the DOJ under the HSR Act regarding its pending acquisition by Transocean Ltd. Under the Business Combination Agreement dated February 9, 2026, Transocean will acquire all Valaris shares in exchange for 15.235 Transocean shares per Valaris share. The Second Request extends the HSR waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance by both parties. The parties are cooperating with the DOJ. The risk-arb angle is to monitor the antitrust review timeline and any potential divestiture requirements that could delay or alter the deal.
